label: Dagu DGServo 9g header
description:
Dagu DGServo 9g header (male)

This part is a minor variation of the standard three pin header; in schematic view the pins have been labelled to show clearly pulse, Vcc and ground. Plug this header into a breadboard, stripboard or PCB to allow a servo header female connector plug (e.g. on the Dagu DGServo 9g) to be connected to the board.
